title: Evidence coverage measurement (foundational)
description: Coverage is measured as the fraction of the mission's subquestions that have at least one supporting source above the support threshold. A mission can feel complete while half its subquestions are actually unanswered; the coverage number makes the gap visible. Coverage is recomputed after every batch of new evidence. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example.
demo:
subs = {'q1': 0.8, 'q2': 0.5, 'q3': 0.1, 'q4': 0.7}
TH = 0.35
cov = sum(1 for s in subs.values() if s >= TH) / len(subs)
print(f'evidence coverage: {cov:.0%}')
provenance: Public computer-science methods literature (Stopping-Criterion Evaluator practice); cross-checked against standard references, 2026-10-21.

title: Sufficiency threshold per mission type (foundational)
description: The sufficiency threshold is set from the mission's stakes: a casual overview stops at 60 percent coverage, a decision-grade investigation demands 90. Thresholds are declared in the mission plan, not improvised mid-search when fatigue sets in. Declared thresholds keep stopping honest. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example.
provenance: Public computer-science methods literature (Stopping-Criterion Evaluator practice); cross-checked against standard references, 2026-10-21.

title: Marginal value estimate of continuing (foundational)
description: Before deciding, the evaluator estimates the marginal value of more searching: the recent rate of new-evidence discovery times the importance of the still-unanswered subquestions. If the discovery rate has flatlined, continuing is unlikely to help no matter how important the gaps are. The estimate turns 'should we keep going' from a feeling into a number. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example.
demo:
recent_new = [5, 3, 1, 0]  # new evidence per batch
gap_importance = 0.8
marginal = (sum(recent_new[-2:]) / 2) * gap_importance
print('marginal value of continuing:', round(marginal, 2), '-> STOP' if marginal < 1 else '-> CONTINUE')
provenance: Public computer-science methods literature (Stopping-Criterion Evaluator practice); cross-checked against standard references, 2026-10-21.

title: Stop/continue decision record (foundational)
description: The decision is recorded with its inputs: coverage, threshold, marginal value, and the resulting verdict. A recorded decision can be audited later, which matters when someone asks why an investigation stopped with questions open. The record also notes who or what made the call. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example.

title: Continue plan with targeted gaps (foundational)
description: When the verdict is continue, the evaluator outputs a targeted plan naming exactly which subquestions remain and what kind of evidence would close each. Targeted continuation beats undirected 'search more' every time. The plan becomes the next iteration's marching orders for the search agent. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example.
provenance: Public computer-science methods literature (Stopping-Criterion Evaluator practice); cross-checked against standard references, 2026-10-21.
